svg.title: EDIT-4 Atlas Editor: annotated pre-build viewport and state board
svg.desc: Proposed UI only. Full S24+ 1080 by 2340 portrait, dark and light at 200 percent text, a 2340 by 1080 landscape layout, and ten state thumbnails. Synthetic image. No current-device evidence.

E STATE PROOF · DISTINCT PROPOSED FRAMES · SYNTHETIC MEDIA
Saving: no double submit; success only after MediaStore write + readback + refresh. Failure retains recipe.
Back / Cancel / system gesture share dirty guard. Light/dark and 200% type layouts are proposals.
Unsupported HDR / HEIF / motion: explicit safe choice, never silent loss. No real photos, device or benchmark used.
